status: Prepared-projection ownership continuation of ordered unit1; typed immutable FramePlan and complete GPI-S4 adoption/qualification remain open.
authority: PM049 and exact owner-approved proposal r2
change: RenderSession now owns the prepared projection for Main and every owned native dialog. Runtime/global dialog nullable cache fields are removed; readers use the shared accessor.

Main/native dialogs/capture encode one borrowed immutable scene via a move-and-restore envelope without geometry cloning. A semantic revision change during encoding prevents restoring an obsolete snapshot.

Only accepted native completion can create hit/Console publication. Capture, failure and old completion cannot publish a newer prepared projection; cached exposures cannot replace displayed hits with the consumed empty vector.
Target retirement invalidates prepared and unpublished projection state, preserving retained CPU content and terminal damage. This prevents recovered dialogs inheriting consumed hit maps.
verification_rationale: Shared storage and publication alter all native/capture adapters. CPU negative controls prove revision/capture/recovery policy. Two existing hidden X11 tests verify actual scale/extent hit publication and serial Main/GLOBAL/PROJECT/NEW presentation with an added offscreen capture isolation assertion. Native checks use a pinned real board and isolated XDG settings; no performance schedule or tuning.

verification.clippy: affected GUI app/render all-target visual passed; initial compile caught two old-field references in owned-dialog test helpers, corrected to shared accessors

review.scope: Read-only advisory review of shared prepared-projection ownership migration. No edits, builds, tests or native runs. CPU work excluded.
review.disposition: No remaining blocking finding in this bounded prepared-ownership continuation after recovery fix. Advisory source review only; no independent builds/tests/runs or completed PM049 acceptance. Per-attempt immutable FramePlan/publication adoption remains pending as previously noted.

findings.finding: Auxiliary recovery installs a fresh empty PresentedHitRegions, but now transfers an already-presented PreparedScene and prepared_hits_pending=false in RenderSession. That PreparedScene hit vector was moved out previously. retire_target does not invalidate prepared/publication; next recovered dialog render skips rebuild and emits no hit publication. All three auxiliary kinds can therefore render but retain empty input hit maps after recovery. Previously replacement.prepared=None forced reconstruction.
findings.required: Invalidate prepared projection/pending publication on target retirement/recovery while preserving leased terminal damage and retained CPU source content, or explicitly transfer and rebind correct hit state. For this unit, rebuilding matches historical recovery behavior. Cover previously-presented dialog→replacement empty input owner→retirement→fresh preparation→matching presentation publication.
findings.resolution: retire_target clears prepared, prepared_hits_pending and queued publication while retaining CPU content and terminal lease. resize_content delegates to it. Existing recovery commit invokes retire_target after transferring RenderSession, forcing auxiliary rebuild. Added source control covers consumed hit map, retirement removing projection/publication and later matching presentation publishing fresh hits. Reviewer did not execute it.

review_notes: Main, all dialog kinds, and capture now move PreparedScene through with_prepared_scene rather than deep cloning it. Normal result success/error restores the same envelope when semantic revision is unchanged; changed revision prevents restoring stale content.

Only accepted matching native completion constructs publication; failed/deferred/dropped/capture paths do not take hits or retire lease. Capture retains the projection for subsequent native use, without publishing native input state.

Composition/content/resize transitions remove shared prepared state. Current native adapters synchronously take publication immediately after accepted present, preserving last displayed app hit map through ordinary preparation failure.

prepared_revision comparison prevents an old receipt from publishing a newer replacement. This continuation does not yet own a per-attempt immutable publication snapshot: if semantic changes are allowed between encoding and present, skipping newer publication is safe against speculative hits but cannot publish the older frame actually displayed. Current synchronous adapters do not interleave semantic updates there; final FramePlan adoption must bind the rendered snapshot, not merely current shared prepared state.

Test-only PresentedHitRegions mark_pending/present remains historical helper; future behavior tests must exercise shared complete_frame/take_published_frame production path, not only that legacy test helper.
App terminal cache and camera/grid construction plus diagnostic/test scene_dirty remain explicitly transitional; this migration is not complete PM049 adoption.
